scripts.dev:full: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile full up -d --build
scripts.dev:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile migrate run --rm migrate
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile migrate run --rm --entrypoint sh migrate -c "npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts"
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile full --profile tunnel down
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile full --profile tunnel down -v
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile full --profile tunnel logs -f
scripts.dev:ps: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env --profile full --profile tunnel ps
